recommendations.notes: N: federal DüV Anlage 4 N-Bedarfswert at reference yield — a LEGAL UPPER LIMIT (Düngebedarfsermittlung), NOT an agronomic optimum. Soil mineral N (Nmin), previous crop and manure history are subtracted; adjustment ±10 kg N/ha per 10 dt yield deviation; 170 kg N/ha/year organic-N cap. P/K: LWK Niedersachsen Grunddüngung 2020, soil class C, medium reference yield (ranges 80–50 P₂O₅, 150–90 K₂O recorded as midpoints). No Bayern- or NRW-specific P₂O₅/K₂O tables found (see gaps).
